name: Can't Buy Me Love
description: A young man gets entangled in a kidnap-for-ransom situation. He offers the kidnappers all his hard-earned money to save the victim, believing that her wealthy Filipino-Chinese family could easily repay him, or so he thought.

credits_cast.character: Salvacion de Jesus Bongon / Lola Nene
credits_cast.name: Nova Villa

videos.title: A Family Affair
videos.overview: Aspiring entrepreneur Bingo lands a chance at a life-changing business grant — only to get derailed when wealthy young Caroline causes a bus collision.

videos.title: The Eclipse
videos.overview: A confrontation at her half-sister's engagement ceremony leaves Caroline in a rocky position with her family. Meanwhile, Bingo sneaks in with a plan.

videos.title: The Grand Eyeball
videos.overview: Bingo makes a clandestine deal for his grandmother's eye transplant, while a criminal gang targets Caroline in a scheme.

videos.title: The Anti-hero
videos.overview: Bingo has no choice but to try and escape a deadly situation with an unconscious Caroline. But his gamble comes at a tremendous cost.

videos.title: The Mad Woman
videos.overview: Still hiding from her family, Caroline looks for a way to pay back Bingo - who tails her around the city and finds her in more trouble.

videos.title: The Constitution
videos.overview: Caroline tries to make sense of her abduction, while Bingo refuses to leave her alone. Wilson contemplates the future of the company.

videos.title: Foot Forward
videos.overview: After the police interrogate Bingo, Caroline reluctantly strikes a deal with him to try to get to the bottom of the mystery.

videos.title: Takes One to Know One
videos.overview: Bingo questions Snoop about his involvement in the abduction and urges him to make things right. A tragedy from the past haunts Caroline.

videos.title: Stop and Go
videos.overview: Caroline recounts the events surrounding her kidnapping as Bingo helps figure out their next move. Cindy prepares for the upcoming power struggle.

videos.title: Just to See You
videos.overview: Bingo and Snoop draw out a lead after they run into a familiar face at a wake. As the list of suspects grows, Caroline decides whom to go after first.

videos.title: The Missing Piece
videos.overview: Caroline ropes Bingo into a devious plan to check out one of their suspects. Later, she stumbles upon a surprising new clue.

videos.title: This Gathering
videos.overview: As she tells Bingo of her discovery, Caroline looks back on her relationship with one of her half sisters. Edward mysteriously disappears.

videos.title: Blame Game
videos.overview: Bingo receives an ominous message from a gangster. A family meeting doesn't go as planned after Caroline makes an unexpected announcement.

videos.title: No Easy Way Out
videos.overview: After a close call on the road, Bingo convinces Caroline to remain in hiding. Albert sets his sights on wrangling a better business deal out of Wilson.

videos.title: Trouble Will Find Me
videos.overview: While looking for leads with Snoop, Bingo notices a crucial detail when he recognizes a shifty man from afar. Caroline bumps into the neighbors.

videos.title: Danger Stranger
videos.overview: Bingo and Snoop frantically search for Caroline as a suspicious group stalks around the tenement. A favor from a friend leads to a new suspect.

videos.title: How You Get the Girl
videos.overview: Wilson's abrupt announcement catches Albert off guard. At a flashy nightclub, Bingo teams up with Jersey and makes a move on Irene.

videos.title: The Sister
videos.overview: Bettina weighs the cost of her ambition. A cyberattack against the Golden Lotus Corporation threatens to ruin its reputation.

videos.title: Drunk Walk Home
videos.overview: Wilson's team scrambles to respond to an ongoing threat. After Bingo returns from Irene's house, he finds an irate Caroline.

videos.title: On the Rocks
videos.overview: With enough evidence in hand, Caroline prepares to move back in with her family. Bingo's investigation brings him face to face with an old friend.

videos.title: Send in the Clowns
videos.overview: Bingo learns how a tragic incident connects to his past. Kap's birthday party unintentionally puts the local community in danger.

videos.title: The Trick
videos.overview: The neighbors rally behind Bingo after he comes clean about Caroline's abduction. Meanwhile, a new scheme targets another Tiu sibling.

videos.title: Irene's Secret
videos.overview: Despite her father's wishes, Caroline insists on heading out to search for Irene and inadvertently learns a long-hidden secret.

videos.title: My Kidnapper
videos.overview: Charleston takes drastic measures to find the hackers behind the Golden Lotus breach. Bingo and Snoop's latest mission ends in a tense standoff.

videos.title: What Matters Most
videos.overview: After Snoop figures out a way to track down Irene, Caroline and Bingo head to her location and find her in a desperate situation.

videos.title: Head-On Collision
videos.overview: Questions about Bingo's past continue to haunt him, even as life returns to normal. Wilson puts up reward money for Balong's capture.

videos.title: Message Sent
videos.overview: Bingo finds out who caused the bus collision that ruined his business prospects, but a dinner invitation presents him with a chance to revive his pitch.

videos.title: The Parentals
videos.overview: As Bingo and Snoop prepare to meet the Tius, Caroline receives cryptic messages from someone who claims to know secrets from her childhood.

videos.title: The Dinner Party
videos.overview: At the Tiu family dinner, Edward and Charleston trade barbs while Bingo asks Wilson an unexpected question. Snoop tries to get to know Irene.

videos.title: OPIP
videos.overview: Caroline heads to a covert meeting with her mysterious acquaintance. Bingo prepares for his grandmother's surgery, only to encounter new complications.

videos.title: Bad Blood
videos.overview: Bingo faces the Tiu siblings as he pitches his business plan at the Golden Lotus office. Later, Caroline pays his family a surprise visit.

videos.title: Illicit Affairs
videos.overview: Charleston's search for the hacker points to a notoriously elusive cybercriminal. Meanwhile, Caroline gets wind of a shady plot.

videos.title: The Elusive Million
videos.overview: When a fight between Caroline and Irene gets out of hand, Wilson thinks of a suitable punishment. Bingo and Snoop find a new way to make some cash.

videos.title: Students of Life
videos.overview: Wilson's mentor takes in Caroline and Irene as part of her restaurant's staff, but they start at the very bottom. Bingo tries his hand at live selling.

videos.title: Strange Fellows
videos.overview: As Caroline and Irene scramble to adapt to their new jobs, Wilson and Cindy accuse one of their children of a serious crime.

videos.title: The Mastermind
videos.overview: Confused after their recent encounter, Bingo looks for Caroline at the restaurant. The family mistrusts one of their own after an apparent betrayal.

videos.title: One Last Favor
videos.overview: Bingo attends a free marketing talk to up his game. Caroline gets an unlikely visitor at work as she tries to get to the bottom of her family's dilemma.

videos.title: Caught in the Middle
videos.overview: Bingo cuts Snoop in on his deal with Caroline, who wants him to find out what her target is hiding. Charleston opens up to Carlo to try to win him over.

videos.title: Told You So
videos.overview: Cindy finds a drunk Irene and makes her feel guilty for quitting her job. Caroline and Bingo stalk Jaime as he leaves his office.

videos.title: Big Man, Little Dignity
videos.overview: Hoping to collect evidence, Snoop and Bingo shadow Jaime to a clandestine meeting. Charleston swears revenge on the person behind his downfall.

videos.title: All for the Money
videos.overview: Bingo acquires evidence of Edward and Jaime's connection. However, to Caroline's dismay, this proof falls short of establishing the men's alliance in hacking GL Bank. Meanwhile, Bettina begins to harbor doubts about her relationship with Edward.

videos.title: Cracking the Code
videos.overview: With Bingo's evidence yielding nothing substantial or incriminating, Caroline decides to conclude their investigation on Jaime. The Tius count down to Bettina and Edward’s wedding day, and Snoop just finds a way to decode the audioless video.

videos.title: Eyes Wide Open
videos.overview: Charleston makes his way to Edward to exact revenge for the wrongs the latter did to his family. As Bingo and Caroline race against time to stop Charleston, they come across a horrifying discovery.

videos.title: Aftershock
videos.overview: The Tius are at their wits' end over the shocking news of Edward’s death. Extremely worried about Caroline, Bingo and his family try to come up with ways to console the young lady.

videos.title: So Many Questions, So Few Answers
videos.overview: The Tius grow troubled when Bettina gets invited by the police for questioning about Edward's death. Caroline reaches out to Charleston, while Bingo goes out of his way to help her.

videos.title: As A Friend
videos.overview: Wilson and Cindy try to find a way to prove Bettina’s innocence in Edward’s murder. Bingo seeks to talk with Caroline after recalling that he saw Bettina near the crime scene.

videos.title: Under Arrest
videos.overview: Caroline drowns herself with work to take her mind off the mounting issues burdening her family. Bingo, facing a fair share of setbacks in Snoobidora, comes to Caroline’s rescue with a vital piece of information and a thoughtful gesture.

videos.title: Make It Right
videos.overview: Irene yet again crosses paths with Snoop and finally realizes who he is. As the Liaos try to pin Edward’s murder on Bettina, Caroline and her family turn to Bingo for help.

videos.title: Take Two
videos.overview: Bingo agrees to testify for Bettina. Despite the young man’s kindness, however, Wilson and Cindy remain skeptical about his credibility. Unknown to the Tius, someone close to them has been employing underhanded tricks to further implicate Bettina.

videos.title: The Truth Untold
videos.overview: Wilson and Cindy grow concerned over Bettina as the DNA test results of the evidence in Edward's case are released. Following Nene's request, Bingo invites Caroline to dinner.

videos.title: Safe Space
videos.overview: Caroline defends Bettina from the Liaos, only to find herself at the receiving end of Cindy's blame. Luckily, there is one place she can always run to in times of need. Meanwhile, Charleston takes Bettina’s case into his own hands.

videos.title: Testify My Love
videos.overview: Bettina’s lawyers prepare Bingo for his court testimony. Brooding over his interrupted phone conversation with Caroline, Bingo shows up at her new workplace. Cindy and Gina are shocked to the core upon learning of Bingo’s connection with Annie.

videos.title: Fair Lady
videos.overview: Thanks to Bingo’s statement and Edward’s recovered toxicology report, Bettina is finally out of jail. Bingo refuses to accept any reward from the Tius and asks Caroline for a favor instead. Dara and her friends get back at Irene.

videos.title: Ride with You
videos.overview: After taking Caroline to the carnival, Bingo gives her a night to remember. Irene gets a taste of her own medicine when she retaliates against Dara and her friends.

videos.title: Tables Turning
videos.overview: While Caroline struggles to manage her team in the warehouse, a new opportunity opens for Bingo who resolves to work harder for his friends. Bettina shares with Cindy her doubts about Edward’s case.

videos.title: Heiress Behavior
videos.overview: Caroline meets up with Bingo to vent her frustrations about work. Little does she know, new challenges await her as Cathy introduces the warehouse’s new operations manager.

videos.title: Usual Suspect
videos.overview: Failing to sway Cathy for a transfer, Caroline persists in giving Bingo the cold shoulder at work. The clash of ideologies between the two intensifies when Caroline levels a serious allegation against one of the warehouse workers.

videos.title: Highly Intelligent Daugther
videos.overview: Caroline reaches out to Bingo and offers to bring him home to clear the air between them. Witnessing the pair’s growing closeness, Bingo’s friends deem it necessary for Bougie to finally make a move before it is too late.

videos.title: Anger Management
videos.overview: Caroline comes up with an idea to optimize warehouse operations, potentially jeopardizing the jobs of numerous workers. Irene gives Snoop a tempting offer.

videos.title: Save/Delete
videos.overview: Caroline gets into trouble at work for delving into the warehouse workers’ personal lives. Charleston and Carlo discreetly move to cover up an important detail in Edward’s death.

videos.title: Who are You?
videos.overview: Nene arranges a meeting for Bingo and Caroline. Unbeknownst to Bingo, an all-dressed-up Bougie excitedly awaits him for their date. Snoop provides his first service for Irene.

videos.title: Twisted Nightmare
videos.overview: The pain from Caroline's traumatic past resurfaces vividly upon discovering that Wilson got rid of her only memory of her mother. Haunted by their own ghosts, Cindy and Gina scramble to find Annie.

videos.title: You'll Be Safe Here
videos.overview: Irene and Snoop reach a truce and agree to be drinking buddies for the night. Seeking solace from her sorrows, Caroline immerses herself in work, only to later find herself trapped alone inside the warehouse on a dark and chilling night.

videos.title: Lady Bird
videos.overview: Bingo becomes worried when Caroline fails to report to work. Unbeknownst to him, Caroline resolves to finally address her pent-up feelings. Gina gets wind of Carlo and Charleston’s suspicious activities.

videos.title: Midnight
videos.overview: Caroline sneaks out at midnight to confront the questions lingering in her mind about her mother's death. Pushed into a corner, Charleston finally comes clean to Gina.

videos.title: Unbecoming
videos.overview: Bingo insists on helping Caroline find Pato. However, Caroline's personal activities start interfering with work. Meanwhile, the Tius hire a new crisis manager.

videos.title: Master
videos.overview: After getting an earful from Cathy, Caroline thinks of a way to make it up to the former. Stressed out at her kitchen duties, Irene contacts Snoop. Meanwhile, Charleston issues Gina a warning.

videos.title: Clear and Present Danger
videos.overview: Caroline digs for information about her hunch that there is a connection between Edward’s death and Pato’s disappearance. Bingo grows worried about Caroline upon noticing a familiar face near the warehouse.

videos.title: The Real Score
videos.overview: When Jersey asks for help, Bingo rushes to Caroline without a word. Irene's paranoia intensifies as Cathy suddenly starts acting differently toward her.

videos.title: Closer Together
videos.overview: Caroline eludes her bodyguards to sneak into Edward’s penthouse. However, her mission proves more complicated than anticipated as the deceased man’s unit remains under close watch. Grace finds the perfect man to replace Wilson as the CEO of GLC.

videos.title: Closer to You
videos.overview: Caroline comes close to danger as she furthers her investigation, forcing Bingo to come to her aid. Meanwhile, Irene dreads the possibility of being pregnant.

videos.title: A Different Light
videos.overview: Bingo’s persistence bears fruit when Caroline finally lets him in on her mission to uncover the connection between Edward and Pato. The pair's constant collaboration, however, begins to alarm Charleston and Carlo.

videos.title: Let You In
videos.overview: Bingo and Caroline manage to get a lead on Edward's possible killer, but an unpleasant encounter puts Bingo's safety at risk. Filled with concern, Caroline opens up about her childhood trauma.

videos.title: Red
videos.overview: Caroline makes a realization after Bingo's accident. Upon learning of Caroline’s emotional struggles, Bingo gets reminded of a painful past he has been trying to avoid.

videos.title: Home is Where the Heart Is
videos.overview: Monching’s plan to work overseas reaches his family in an untimely manner. This leads to an emotional confrontation with Bingo, worsening the latter’s condition. Two women return home, each with ulterior motives in mind.

videos.title: Now or Never
videos.overview: Gina delves deep into Liv’s connection to Edward’s death. Bettina reunites with her family, finally revealing her true intentions. Caroline visits Bingo and unexpectedly witnesses a love confession.

videos.title: Bubbling Up
videos.overview: Bougie confesses her feelings for Bingo. Jersey observes something unusual about Caroline when her friend unexpectedly invites her out to shop. Later, Caroline learns sensitive information about Bingo.

videos.title: Axe to Grind
videos.overview: Caroline begins to see Bingo in a new light. Snoop talks some sense into Bingo over the latter’s strong opposition to Monching’s plan to work overseas. Wilson welcomes the Chinese New Year with an important family announcement.

videos.title: Too Soon For Goodbyes
videos.overview: A heated argument breaks out among the Tius when Bettina confronts Charleston about his secret. Caroline’s business presentation deeply moves Cathy, prompting the latter to make an unexpected announcement.

videos.title: A Flurry Of Feathers
videos.overview: Bingo and the warehouse workers bid farewell to Caroline as she finishes her training with Cathy. Caroline remains in denial about her feelings for Bingo. Bettina sets her sights on a new target.

videos.title: Driver
videos.overview: Cathy invites Caroline to the restricted room to share a life lesson. Still in denial of her feelings toward Bingo, Caroline finds herself reaching out to him. Meanwhile, Charleston and Carlo issue Liv a warning.

videos.title: An Invitation
videos.overview: Caroline's mood brightens upon learning the real score between Bingo and Bougie. Meanwhile, as her revenge plot against the Tius is already in the works, Annie looks forward to reuniting with her estranged son.

videos.title: Stage Fright
videos.overview: Bingo is torn between joining the Mr. Binondo pageant and attending a New Year’s Eve party with Caroline. More questions arise within Caroline after overhearing Charleston and Bettina’s argument.

videos.title: Ready or Not
videos.overview: Caroline anxiously waits for Bingo to arrive at the New Year’s Eve party. Unknown to her, Stephen has prepared a romantic surprise for her. Meanwhile, Wilson bumps into a familiar face.

videos.title: Party Pooper
videos.overview: Bingo witnesses a love confession just when he arrives at the New Year’s Eve party. While everyone gets into the festive mood as they celebrate the Chinese New Year, Gina is shocked to see a familiar party guest.

videos.title: Total Control
videos.overview: Sneaking out of the New Year's Eve party, Bingo and Caroline exchange vows for their business. While Cindy is thrown into panic, Annie and Sherwin begin plotting their next move against the Tius.

videos.title: Mothers
videos.overview: Annie brims with satisfaction as Sherwin replaces Wilson as GLC’s CEO. After spying on Liv, Bingo invites Ling to dinner. Irene resolves to take the only step that will help her confirm her suspicions about the night she shared with Snoop.

videos.title: Love is a Trap
videos.overview: Nene and Monching help Bingo prepare for his dinner date with Caroline. To Bingo’s dismay, an uninvited guest insists on joining them. Meanwhile, Irene and Snoop revisit the latter’s place to recall every little detail on the night they got drunk.

videos.title: Poison
videos.overview: Caroline and Bingo's efforts to follow Liv bear fruit as the truth behind Edward's death comes to light. Cindy and Gina finally come face-to-face with Annie.

videos.title: Nice to Meet You
videos.overview: Bingo is forced to make a confession when Caroline accidentally learns about his deal with Cathy. Soon, Caroline finally meets the person who can possibly provide answers to her questions.

videos.title: The World Collapses
videos.overview: As Caroline learns about Annie's connection with Divine, Cindy and Gina grow more and more anxious. Bingo decides to go after Caroline, only to stumble upon a ghost from his past.

videos.title: One Million Reasons
videos.overview: Bingo's deep resentment toward Annie gets him into a fight. Armed with Pato's revelations, Caroline confronts Cindy over her alleged involvement in Divine's demise. Bettina lets Sherwin know about her real intention.

videos.title: When It Rains
videos.overview: Tension fills the Tiu mansion after Caroline dropped the truth bomb about Cindy’s alleged involvement in her mother’s death. Meanwhile, Bingo brims with anger as he recounts his painful encounter with his estranged mother.

videos.title: Matter of Destiny
videos.overview: Bingo finds himself between a rock and a hard place as Nene’s medical bills pile up. Ling makes a life-changing decision as she remains adamant about unearthing the truth regarding Divine’s death.

videos.title: A Lot Like Love
videos.overview: Bingo and Caroline finally have their much-needed conversation. While Gina thinks of a way to stop Annie from her plan, Cindy gives Stephen an important mission.

videos.title: A Boy's Wish
videos.overview: Irene opens up to Snoop about her frustrations with her family. Bingo tags along with Caroline, unaware that she is going to meet with Annie. Sherwin nominates GLC's new COO.

videos.title: Mothering
videos.overview: A heated argument erupts between Bingo and Annie amid Caroline's attempt to seek answers about Divine's death. Tension rises at GLC over the appointment of its new COO. Irene's much-awaited moment finally arrives.

videos.title: The Past Is Never in the Past
videos.overview: Bingo gives Caroline reassurance despite his deep-seated hatred toward Annie. Caroline, meanwhile, receives an unexpected call from Pato. The Tiu siblings' fight over GLC's COO post continues.

videos.title: The Queen's Secret
videos.overview: Caroline and Bingo are shocked to the core as Balong’s arrest opens a can of worms. Defending herself and Wilson from accusations, Cindy resolves to reveal Divine’s secret.

videos.title: A Right Choice
videos.overview: Cindy vows to protect her family as she recalls the events surrounding Divine's death. Caroline sets her sights on proving her mother's innocence. Wilson turns to Cathy for advice in resolving his children's conflict.

videos.title: How To Move On
videos.overview: Bingo seeks help from an unlikely person in his search for Gilbert Bautista. Irene makes an arrangement with Snoop for her next training. Cindy and Gina prepare Charleston and Carlo, respectively, for the election of GLC's new COO.

videos.title: Top of The World
videos.overview: Sherwin lays out his plan to use Bettina to ruin the Tius. Irene meets a former schoolmate at Cathy’s warehouse. Bingo and Caroline enjoy each other’s company during their business trip.

videos.title: Game On
videos.overview: A few minor mishaps bring Caroline and Bingo closer to each other as they arrive in La Sinfonia. Snoop checks in on Irene, only to witness a baffling scene.

videos.title: Your call
videos.overview: Caroline and Bingo waste no time pitching their proposal upon meeting the man who can help with their business plan. Back at GLC, the Tius vote for their next COO.

videos.title: Big Winner
videos.overview: Annie and Sherwin set their sights on their next target now that GLC's new COO has been named. Bingo admits to Caroline the real reason for their visit to La Sinfonia.

videos.title: You'll Be Unsafe Here
videos.overview: Old secrets unravel after a family member strikes at Bingo and Caroline, just as the rest of the Tius scramble to find them.

videos.title: The Unshoppable List
videos.overview: Bingo and Caroline navigate love, grief and second chances as they leave the past behind to face an uncertain future together.
